facts.value: One set of transcripts from every college and university from which you earned a bachelor’s degree or higher must be sent to ASU.

facts.value: Official transcripts must be sent directly to ASU Admission Services from the issuing institution's records office either by mail or through a secured electronic transcript service.

facts.value: International students must submit proof of English proficiency.
